text:
Type: slim light wood framed wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, checking an outfit, making a space feel larger; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: mirror glass, thin frame in a light oak or birch effect finish
Colors: light natural wood, silver mirror
Shape: tall rectangle with a very narrow flat frame, clean straight lines, simple and light
Feel: calm, airy, clean, natural
Goes with: light wood furniture, white walls, linen and wool textiles; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: STAVE
product.description: Can be hung horizontally or vertically.
